messages.subject: inla-spde for very large dataset / projection grid
parts:
Hello dear INLA community,

I'm working with a very large spatial dataset with 1,134,465 points. I believe I'm facing a memory issue, as I've only 16gb. I've followed lots of threads regarding the subject and I've tried different things to workaround. I used num.threads, diagonal, int.strategy='eb', verbose=TRUE, and none worked. Lately I've been working with a subset with 16,000 points (you can see that option in my code), though for the prediction it's essential that I have the same resolution as the original raster, so the prediction grid is huge and when I run inla(), it crashes.

I attached my code so maybe you can see a mistake that I don't. This code was shrunk for the post, as it had a comparison between different models with different covariates. It has only the model chosen for predictions (r.lin.srtmL).

Do you have any idea how to workaround this issue or is it only memory that will probably fix it? I still have the possibility to access a 32gb RAM PC, though with Windows, which crashes more often when using INLA.

Thank you on advance!

Huriel Reichel
